name: Haus Sarah
beschreibung: The Haus Sarah is nestled in a quiet, sunny setting on Wiesenweg in Neustift im Stubaital. Lovingly finished with traditional alpine timber furniture, the guest rooms feature private en-suite bathrooms with shower/WC, satellite TV, and sunny balconies overlooking the magnificent Stubai mountain scenery. In the morning, a hearty breakfast buffet filled with regional Tyrolean produce fuels guests for active days of skiing or mountain trekking. The free ski bus stop is only a short walk away, offering straightforward transfers to the slopes of the Stubai Glacier and the nearby family ski areas of Schlick 2000 and Elfer. Summer brings prime access to the famed Stubai High Trail and scenic highlights like the Grawa Waterfall.
kurzbeschreibung: Cosy bed and breakfast on Wiesenweg in Neustift im Stubaital with traditional wood furnishings and close to the Stubai Glacier.
